artworks.title: Jan Uytenbogaert
artworks.artist: Jan van der Bruggen after Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a figure in rich clothing in a trade setting. The central figure is behind a table with various goods such as papers, a balance scale, and sacks or fabrics. Nearby are barrels and a large trunk. Another figure is seen in conversation with the central one. In the foreground, a small creature is by a basket of fruits, eating. The scene is indoors with an arched window showing faint landscape elements.

artworks.title: Title Plate
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate decorated tablet with Dutch text and two figures, one on each side. The tablet is framed with garlands of fruit, foliage, and decorative ribbons, and features two individuals seated on either side. The figure on the left is in a relaxed pose and wearing simple clothing with a brimmed hat, seated on what appears to be a sack. The figure on the right is also in a relaxed position, seated next to a wooden barrel, wearing a hat and elaborate attire. The text within the tablet provides bibliographical information in Gothic script about a publication by Willem Buytewech from 1621, printed in Amsterdam. Radiating lines behind the tablet suggest illumination or a source of light.

artworks.title: Ruined Tower Right of Center
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with ruins of a large stone structure to the right. The horizon line is low, emphasizing the height of the ruin. The ruin is detailed with fine lines. More ruins and structures are visible in the distance. A path curves along the base of the structure, with a solitary figure on it. The sky above the horizon has a textured appearance. The color scheme is monochrome, highlighting details and the aging of the structures.

artworks.title: Two Ruins (Huys te Kleef near Haarlem)
artworks.description: The image shows the ruins of a castle or large structure from a slightly elevated, side-on perspective. The horizon is placed relatively high, showing open land and low hills rolling away into the distance on the right side. The ruins are set on this horizon and are the focal point. The artwork uses detailed, linear brushstrokes resembling an etching or pen and ink drawing, creating texture and shading. The color palette is monochromatic, using only shades of black and white. Near the ruins, a small figure of a person can be seen walking, adding scale to the vastness of the scene.

artworks.title: Road at the Edge of the Forest
artworks.description: The etching depicts a scene of a winding dirt path flanked by trees on the left. A small structure or cart stands in the distance, while a thatched-roof building is visible further away on the right. The high horizon line adds depth to the image. The etching features detailed lines and dots, creating a textured style with fine strokes illustrating the trees and path. The color palette is monochrome, emphasizing the contrast between the dark ink and light background, capturing a rural scene with a sense of calm and emptiness.

artworks.title: The Sower
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a low horizon and a line of trees in the foreground. A thatched-roof structure with chimneys is visible beyond the trees. The artwork features intricate linework, delicate strokes constructing the trees and terrain. The trees have sparse foliage and elegant slim trunks. A small figure with a hat is walking along a path, contributing to the sense of scale. The color palette is monochrome, with shades of gray and black.

artworks.title: The House with the Stepped Gable
artworks.description: The image shows a view from a slightly elevated position, overlooking an area with lush vegetation and a large building to the left. The horizon is not sharply defined, as the trees and the building block a clear line at the landscape's limit. The brushstrokes are fine and detailed, with meticulous line work that adds texture to the trees and shrubs, as well as the architectural elements of the building. The color palette is monochromatic, consisting only of black ink on a light background, which emphasizes the intricate patterns and textures throughout the scene. On the right, the bare trees rise, their branches extending upwards and outwards, creating a contrast with the organized structure of the building in the rest of the image.

artworks.title: The Charcoal-Burner
artworks.description: The image captures a landscape from an elevated viewpoint, showing a serene natural setting. The horizon is high in the composition with a line of sparse trees. Faint lines of birds are flying just above the trees. The detailed and intricate brushstrokes or etching marks create a fine texture on the foliage and branches. The color palette is monochrome, using shades of black and white. A small stream or river flows through the scene, bordered by trees. In the distance, there is another row of vegetation.

artworks.title: Ruins of a Church (Chapel of Eykenduynen near The Hague)
artworks.description: The image shows a low-angle view of a landscape with architectural ruins and a countryside. The horizon is visible in the lower third, with crumbling structures and a leafless tree. A tall tower with arched openings stands to the right. The artwork uses fine, linear etching to create depth and texture. Various line densities depict forms and distant hills, while the sky is detailed with horizontal lines and stippling. The monochromatic palette of black ink on a pale background emphasizes the historical feel and desolate beauty of the scene.

artworks.title: Scene of Pillage
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8.8 × 19.5 cm (3 7/16 × 7 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered around a rustic building. The scene features a stone-built house with a pitched roof, positioned near the center of the image. The setting appears rural, with trees and a path leading away from the structure. Several figures are engaged around the house, with some holding spears. In the background are more trees and faint structures, suggesting a village or rural landscape. The drawing is detailed and precise, capturing a moment of dynamic interaction amidst peaceful surroundings.

artworks.title: Destruction of a Convent
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 9.5 × 19.4 cm (3 3/4 × 7 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a busy town scene with a horse-drawn carriage and soldiers. The scene shows a historical town square with various activities. There are buildings with many windows and an ornate facade on the left. In the center, a horse-drawn carriage is surrounded by soldiers and people carrying long weapons. On the right, there is a grand building with arched windows and statues at the entrance. Trees are visible in the background. Various figures are scattered throughout the scene, with some appearing to be resting on the ground. The drawing is detailed and textured with the use of fine lines and cross-hatching.

artworks.title: The Letter
artworks.medium: color drypoint, softground etching, and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: We look slightly down onto a young woman sitting at a writing desk as she licks an envelope in this vertical, color print. A table folds down or extends from a tall secretary desk to our right. The blotter on the table and the woman’s long dress are both navy blue. The dress has a vaguely floral pattern in tan, and the jacket is open to reveal a vertically pleated, tan shirt beneath. The woman’s skin is pale peach. Her black hair is pulled back over dark brows and a delicate nose. She holds the open flap of the envelope to her mouth with both hands. The rest of the room is white with a few lines to indicate a corner and a chair. The artist signed the print under the lower right corner, “Mary Cassatt etat.” Another graphite inscription in the lower left corner of the sheet is indecipherable.

artworks.title: Woman Bathing
artworks.medium: color drypoint, softground etching, and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: A pale-skinned woman bends over a basin of water on a washstand in this vertical, colored print. The woman is angled away from us so only her ear and the curve of her forehead are visible beyond her hunched shoulder. Her upper body is bare, her dress having been unfastened so it hangs around her waist. The dress is striped with frosty green, shell pink, and the cream white of the paper. Light gleams on her dark brown hair, which is tied up and back. She cups her hands in the light blue water of the white basin. Two bottles sit at the back corner of the washstand, and a mirror reflects the top of her head. The fawn-brown washstand is boxy, and a handled white pitcher painted with muted pink flowers is at the front left corner, which is closest to us. The wall beyond the washstand is pale, arctic blue, as is the carpet, which is also patterned with pea -green leaves. The artist signed the work in graphite under the lower right corner, “Mary Cassatt.”

artworks.title: The Fitting
artworks.medium: color drypoint, softground etching, and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: Three women are depicted in the image. Two women are shown fully, while one is captured from the back up to her shoulders. The central woman is standing slightly turned to the left with her head gently tilted downward, while the woman on the right side is facing away, showing a side profile. The woman in the foreground is sitting and turned away from the viewer. The central woman has softly defined facial features with delicate shadows on her cheeks, and her hair is dark, short, and coiled close to her scalp. The women are dressed in flowing garments; the two standing women wear patterned dresses in earthy tones, prominently featuring orange with vertical stripes, while the woman sitting is in a light-colored outfit. Small, fine lines suggest the presence of light fabric around the central woman's shoulders. The setting appears to be a simple interior with a contrasting dark and light background, possibly indicating walls or large panels. The scene is devoid of additional ornaments or objects, focusing the viewer's attention on the women's positions and attire.

artworks.title: Christ on the Mount of Olives
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with a figure surrounded by angels and other figures in a woodland setting. The central figure is in a position of devotion and prayer, with outstretched arms. A group in the background is on a pathway. The landscape is detailed with trees and rocky surfaces. The drawing features intricate textures on robes and natural elements, similar to an engraving style used in historical and religious artworks.

artworks.title: Christ Taken Captive
artworks.description: There is a drawing of several figures in a detailed scene. The characters are in varied attire and appear to be part of a dramatic narrative. Some hold weapons like spears and halberds. The background features a landscape with trees and a distant castle or settlement. Bold lines and cross-hatching are used to create texture and depth in the image.

artworks.title: Christ before Annas
artworks.description: The image is a detailed black and white illustration depicting a group scene that includes several people in elaborate clothing, gathered in what appears to be an architectural setting. The people are shown mostly from head to toe, with the central figures being a mix of armored and robed individuals. On the left, there's a crowd of people tightly packed together, and on the right, a distinct figure wearing a long, flowing robe and a hat with intricate details stands apart, possibly on a step. Their facial features are varied, with expressions showing fine detail, framed by hair that ranges from closely cropped to longer and wavier styles. Most individuals appear to wear hats or helmets that complement their attire. The clothing is a mix of armor with decorated shoulder plates and full-length robes. Around the people, there are various architectural elements, including a round arch in the background and a column supporting a ledge where an intricately carved mythical creature seems to perch. This ledge has detailed carvings of faces and foliage. Shields or crests adorn the walls. At the center, there is a curled-up figure, possibly an animal.

artworks.title: Christ before Herod
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a courtly scene with various figures gathered around an ornately decorated throne. The central figure is seated on the throne surrounded by cherubic figures and intricate foliage. They hold a rod and appear to be in conversation with a figure standing before them, who is restrained by a group of soldiers. The standing figure is barefoot, with a simple robe. On the right, a retinue of soldiers, clad in armor and carrying weapons, stands together. The drawing is detailed with intricate linework creating depth. The setting suggests a historical or mythical narrative, steeped in symbolism.

artworks.title: The Flagellation
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures engaging in a physical altercation around a column. The image features intricate line work in black and white, resembling a woodcut style. The central figure is bound to the column, while others around prepare branches or sticks. The figures wear period clothing and display various expressions. Architectural elements are also depicted. The artist conveys intensity and narrative through textures and expressions. This style is reminiscent of a Renaissance artist like Albrecht Dürer.

artworks.title: Pilate Washing His Hands
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing featuring various characters and architectural elements in the style of Albrecht Dürer. The drawing showcases a group of figures gathered around a central figure who appears to be washing their hands in a basin. The figures are dressed in elaborate period-specific clothing such as armor and robes. The scene includes ornate decorations like hanging garlands and a patterned backdrop. The artist uses precise lines and shading techniques to convey texture and depth, characteristic of Renaissance woodcut engravings. The composition balances the figures with the intricate embellishments framing the scene.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.description: This is a black and white drawing of a crucifixion scene. The image features three crosses on a hill, each with a figure on them. The central figure wears a crown of thorns and an inscription plaque above the cross reads "INRI." Surrounding the crosses are numerous figures, some in robes and others in armor, including some on horseback. The detailed line work and shading provide texture and depth to the scene. The sky is filled with cumuliform clouds, adding to the overall dramatic effect.

artworks.title: The Lamentation
artworks.description: The image shows several figures in a somber setting. One central figure lies on the ground, surrounded by others who appear to be attending or mourning him. The central figure is muscular, mostly unclothed, with visible ribs and defined limbs. The surrounding people are positioned closely around him, bending or kneeling, some with their heads covered in shawls or veils. Their facial expressions are serious, and their attire is elaborate, including robes and patterned garments. One person wears a crown. Jewelry is minimal, and the background features a hilly landscape with distant town, a tree, and clouds in a clear sky above. Two heraldic shields are shown in the upper left corner.

artworks.title: A Saxon Prince on Horseback
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated sideways on a horse. The individual is turned slightly to their left, holding the reins with both hands. They have elaborate curly hair under an ornate headpiece adorned with jewels. The person wears a cloak or robe draped over their shoulders, with a patterned garment visible underneath. A chain necklace is visible around their neck. In the background, there is a townscape with towers and spires beyond a wooded area. Two decorative crests hang from a tree branch in the foreground. The artwork is in a monochrome illustrative style, giving a medieval or historical ambiance.

artworks.title: Manet Seated, Turned to the Left (Manet assis, tourné à gauche)
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting on a wooden chair while holding a bowler hat in his lap. He has a full beard and mustache, with wavy hair combed back. The man is wearing a dark overcoat, light shirt, trousers, and shoes.
